description: October 17 birthday meaning: Libra decan 3, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, an October 17 birthday falls in Libra, in the third decan, with Venus as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Libra is cardinal and air.

sections.heading: October 17 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Persuasion is the obvious gift associated with the 17th of October. Twenty-three degrees of Libra sits in the Mercury decan, adding verbal agility to Venusian charm, and seventeen reduces to 8, linked with ambition and authority. The traditional reading is a capable advocate or dealmaker who wins arguments through clarity and courtesy, then remembers to share the credit.

On October 17 the Sun usually sits at about 23° Libra, in the third decan, where Mercury is the sub-ruler alongside Venus. Mercury, ruler of Gemini, colours the final decan of Libra, which runs from around October 14 to October 23. The scales here are weighed with words. Mid-October birthdays are often described as articulate, sociable and quick to see both sides of an argument, sometimes simultaneously. Writing, negotiation, teaching and any role that depends on good conversation tend to suit them. Mercury can add restlessness and a habit of debating rather than deciding. When this decan commits to a view and explains it with Libra's courtesy, it can change minds that more forceful voices never reach.

sections.heading: October 17 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 17th, you have the compound 1 + 7 = 8 as your birthday number. The 1 brings ambition and drive, the 7 brings analysis and inner reflection, and together they feed the 8's practical authority. People born on this day are often described as strategic and independent, with good judgement about money, systems and long-term plans. They tend to think before they act, then act decisively. Read as a secondary number, the 17 is traditionally associated with quiet confidence and with achievement that comes from combining a clear vision with patient attention to detail.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one October 17 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on October 17: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: October birthdays fall in mid-autumn north of the equator, with turning leaves and earlier evenings, and in mid-spring in the southern hemisphere. Libra holds most of the month, with Scorpio arriving around October 23. In numerology October is month 10, which reduces to 1: a number of new starts and independence, carried here with a 0 that is often read as amplifying it. October 17 is the 290th day of the year (291st in a leap year). By October 24, 7 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Scorpio.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by October 17, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on October 17 include Eminem (1972), John Paul I (1912) and Arthur Miller (1915).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is October 17?
faq.answer: October 17 is Libra in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Libra, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on October 17?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On October 17 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 17th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on October 17?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for an October 17 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on October 17?
faq.answer: October 17 is also the birthday of Eminem (1972), John Paul I (1912) and Arthur Miller (1915). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
